paper_id: VL-CheckList_ Evaluating Pre-trained Vision-Language Models with Objects, Attributes and Relations
title: VL-CheckList: Evaluating Pre-trained Vision-Language Models with Objects, Attributes and Relations
motivation: 现有VLP模型仅用下游任务准确率评估，缺乏可解释性、不可比性、数据偏差
problem_framing: 将VLP能力解耦为object/attribute/relation三个独立维度，用ITM作为通用评估目标
key_insight: 借用NLP的CheckList思想，用ITM统一评估并通过负采样构造hard negative测试细粒度能力
method_signature: ITM作为统一评估器 + taxonomy三层解耦 + linguistic-aware负采样
evaluation_criteria: accuracy (正样本得分高于负样本的比例)
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 未解释为何ITM高分模型下游任务分数反而低；CLIP空间关系理解最差(49.1%)
evidence_for_taste: only provides a black box score
disentangle capabilities into relatively independent variables
model-agnostic and applies to all fusion architectures
understanding Relation and Attribute is more challenging than Object
the size in natural language does not translate to an absolute pixel size in images
thinking_moves: 从评估工具缺失反推需要通用探测框架
把复杂下游任务能力分解为可独立测量的原子能力
用负采样构造定向测试而非模糊评估
用ITM作为跨模型的公平比较基准
